voice.name: WTPN Northern Ireland - John
voice.note: warm-toned Northern Irish male — a country parish priest

segments.n_open: The clothes on that bed rose and fell, slow and regular — the way blankets move over a sleeping man. [pause] There was nobody in the bed. I am a priest. I stood and I watched it breathe.
segments.n_s1: A widow, up the mountain at Cooneen, with a house full of children and her husband lately dead. [pause] That is who sent for me. Not a fanciful woman. A woman with the milking to do. She told me there was knocking at her door with nobody at it, and feet crossing the loft over their heads at night, and I said what a priest says. That grief plays tricks. That a house makes noise.
segments.n_s2: Then she told me the rest. [pause] The pots came off the walls. The sheets were pulled off the beds while the children were in them. And the drawers — the drawers would shut on their fingers. [exhales] That is what turned it for me. Noises are one thing. A thing that hurts children in the dark is another thing entirely.
segments.n_s3: So I went up, and I stayed, and I saw what I have told you. The bed breathing with nobody in it. [pause] I had been ordained a good many years by then. I had sat with the dying and I had buried the drowned. I knew what I was looking at, and I knew that I had no name for it.
segments.n_s4: And I was not the only one. Neighbours came. Men who would not be made fools of came and went away quiet. A man who later sat as a Member of Parliament put his name to what happened in that house. [pause] The newspapers had it — the Herald, the Impartial Reporter. It was not a whisper in a townland. It was a public thing, in print, with names on it.
segments.n_s5: They could not live in it. They went to America, and I do not blame one of them for going. [exhales] I stayed a priest in that country another lifetime, and I never took a word of it back, and I never dressed it up either. I do not tell you it was a soul in torment. I do not tell you it was the devil. [pause] I tell you I watched an empty bed breathe, in a house where children were being hurt. Make of it what you will.
